description: This file defines the NodeResource class, which models a node resource entity in the application. It includes properties, constructor, methods for data retrieval (get, getList), save, validation, and related getters for associated images and category.

classes.name: NodeResource
classes.description: Model class representing a node resource with methods for data access, persistence, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of NodeResource, setting default language if not provided.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a node resource record by ID; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of node resources based on filters, pagination, and language.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the node resource instance to the database.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns an Image instance representing the icon.

methods.name: getActionIcon
methods.description: Returns an Image instance representing the action icon.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns an Image instance representing the resource image.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves the category object associated with the resource.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the resource object, ensuring required fields like title are set.
